result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the main “Popular right now” restaurant image appears stuck behind a loading spinner, and some horizontally scrolling content is visibly clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a circular loading spinner centered over the food image while surrounding content is already rendered, suggesting the image is stuck loading or failed to resolve.
issues.suggestion: Add a timeout/fallback for the image, show a placeholder or error state after loading fails, and remove the spinner once the image resolves.

issues.description: The rightmost items in the category chip row and “Fastest near you” carousel are cut off at the screen edge, including the partially visible “Healthy” chip and “Trattoria Piccol…” card.
issues.suggestion: This may be intentional for horizontal scrolling, but add clearer edge fade/peek spacing or ensure the clipped content is consistently partially visible rather than looking accidentally cropped.

issues.description: Restaurant name “Trattoria Piccol…” is truncated due to the card being off-screen, making the full name unreadable in the current viewport.
issues.suggestion: If the card is meant to be browsable without scrolling, reduce card width or font size; otherwise ensure horizontal scroll affordance is obvious.
